name: Mutual Non-Disclosure Agreement (Standard Terms)
description: Standard terms for a mutual NDA allowing each party to share confidential information for a defined purpose, with configurable term, governing law, and confidentiality period.

name: Mutual Non-Disclosure Agreement (Cover Page)
description: Cover page template for the Mutual NDA, used to specify the purpose, effective date, term, governing law, jurisdiction, and party signatures.

name: Cloud Service Agreement
description: Comprehensive agreement for cloud-based SaaS products covering service access, restrictions, privacy and security, payment, term and termination, warranties, liability, indemnification, and confidentiality. Version 2.1.

name: Service Level Agreement
description: Agreement defining uptime and response time commitments for a cloud service, including service credits, termination rights for persistent failures, and definitions for available and downtime minutes. Version 2.0.

name: Design Partner Agreement
description: Agreement for early-access design partners who test a product and provide feedback in exchange for product access, with IP assignment of feedback to the provider.

name: Professional Services Agreement
description: Agreement for professional services engagements covering SOWs, deliverables, IP ownership, subcontractors, payment, warranties, liability, indemnification, insurance, and confidentiality.

name: Data Processing Agreement
description: GDPR-compliant data processing agreement covering processor/subprocessor relationships, processing instructions, EEA and UK restricted transfers (SCCs and UK Addendum), security incident response, audit rights, and data deletion.

name: Partnership Agreement
description: Agreement for business partnerships covering cooperation obligations, payment, trademark licensing (brand elements), privacy, escalation procedures, term, warranties, liability, indemnification, and confidentiality. Version 1.0.

name: Software License Agreement
description: Agreement for on-premise software licensing covering install-and-use rights, user accounts, feedback, machine learning, open source, updates, restrictions, payment, term, warranties, liability, indemnification, and confidentiality. Version 1.1.

name: Pilot Agreement
description: Short-form agreement for product pilots allowing a customer to evaluate a product for a defined period, with AS-IS disclaimer, limited liability, confidentiality, and 30-day termination for any reason. Version 1.1.

name: Business Associate Agreement
description: HIPAA-compliant business associate agreement covering PHI use restrictions, safeguards, subcontractor obligations, individual rights support, breach notification, and data rights (de-identification, aggregation, offshoring). Version 1.0.

name: AI Addendum
description: Addendum to a base agreement covering AI service use, restrictions (no regulated-industry use without human oversight), model training controls (opt-in), non-training improvement, IP ownership of outputs, and AI disclaimers. Version 1.0.
